concepts.definition: Review of each included sprint item and debt entry against the manifest's cited authority. Item outcomes are accepted, local_paydown, design_reframe, requirement_reprice, product_reprice and remove. These are review results, distinct from their consumed core assessments; the named repricing layer is a declared change class carried with the core result.

grounding.quote:
Each classification
 takes exactly one core value

concepts.label: Sprint close review

concepts.definition: A ticket has one durable authoritative record. One markdown file is the default carrier; repository or external tracker carriers are conditional alternatives.

grounding.quote:
Each ticket has one durable authoritative record; the default carrier is
one markdown file.

concepts.label: Durable ticket record

concepts.definition: One admitted upstream work item with more than one build-tenant execution line. Upstream authority and tenant-local tickets have distinct identities and lifecycles. TICKETS owns the work-item/lifecycle relation in urn:stdo:bounded-context:build-tenancy, without redefining tenant identity or realisation; PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8 supplies that context and identity.

grounding.quote:
A multi-build-tenant work item is one admitted upstream work item with more
than one build-tenant execution line. The upstream authority and each
tenant-local ticket retain distinct identities and lifecycles.

concepts.label: Multi-build-tenant work item

concepts.definition: Ticket type describes the kind of work record. The minimum common domain is feature, bug, spike and chore; the default set should suffice in most cases.

grounding.quote:
The minimum common set of ticket types is `feature`, `bug`, `spike` and
`chore`. A project may add more; the default set should be enough for
most cases

concepts.label: Ticket type

concepts.definition: Ticket category specifies execution or migration discipline, independently of type. Its minimum common domain is ordinary and implementation_migration; feature, bug, spike and chore can each carry either category.

grounding.quote:
Ticket category is orthogonal to ticket type: type answers what kind of
work record this is; category answers what execution or migration
discipline governs the ticket

concepts.label: Ticket category

concepts.definition: Implementation_migration denotes governed replacement of one implementation truth path by another across producers, consumers, projections and proof surfaces. Examples include replacing tracker/read-model families, introducing a public interface whose producers and consumers must migrate before closure, and removing a bridge or compatibility facade from an authoritative contract family.

grounding.quote:
a governed
replacement of one implementation truth path with another across producers,
consumers, projections and proof surfaces

concepts.label: Implementation migration

conditions: The migration publishes or admits a new authoritative source carrier.
concepts.definition: The upstream ticket in an implementation-migration wave that publishes or admits its new authoritative source carrier.

grounding.quote:
Tickets that publish or admit
the new authoritative source carrier are the upstream tickets in the wave.

concepts.label: Upstream source-carrier ticket

conditions: Implementation-migration sequencing applies.
concepts.definition: A ticket hardening prompt assembly, projections, reports, dossiers, review surfaces or another downstream consumer.

grounding.quote:
Tickets that harden prompt assembly, projections, reports, dossiers, review
surfaces or other downstream consumers depend on those upstream source
tickets.

concepts.label: Downstream consumer ticket

concepts.definition: The intake-declared class identifying lawful constitutional re-entry, independently of ticket type and category. Named classes include goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice, design_reframe and realization_refactor. The class is a declared state, not an evaluation result.

grounding.quote:
Ticket type and change class are orthogonal: type answers what kind of
work record this is; change class answers where the change lawfully
re-enters the constitutional chain.

concepts.label: Change class

concepts.definition: Intake triage consumes computed classification and treatment for a declared owner/layer traversal, complete relevant public membership and value delta, accepted-design scope and trace coverage, and rule-determined treatment. C, J and O are source-defined annotations; unresolved meaning remains J and reserved choice remains O.

grounding.quote:
Triage consumes the computed classification of
[SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment) for
the declared owner and layer traversal, the complete relevant public
membership and value delta, the accepted-design scope and trace coverage,
and the rule-determined treatment.

concepts.label: Intake triage and upward propagation

concepts.definition: Carrier states include ticket statuses, project-added states, ticket lanes, sprint statuses, migration_strategy, library_usage and recorded change_class. Minimum ticket statuses are backlog, active and completed. These states map to no core value; an evaluation reading a state has its own predicate and core value.

grounding.quote:
The ticket statuses, any local state a project adds, the lanes below, the
sprint statuses of §3 and the `migration_strategy` and `library_usage`
values of §6 are declared states of their carriers, not results, and map
to no core value

concepts.label: Declared carrier state

concepts.definition: Backlog is accepted durable work visible outside current execution focus; active is the bounded current execution set; completed is closed work retained as history. Product bindings ticketing.tickets.lanes.backlog, .active and .completed locate them, defaulting respectively to .ai-workspace/tickets/backlog/, .ai-workspace/tickets/active/ and .ai-workspace/tickets/completed/. Separating lanes keeps live search small and avoids hiding deferred work in comments or goals.

grounding.quote:
`backlog`
is accepted durable work that should remain visible but is not part of the
current execution focus; `active` is the current bounded execution set;
`completed` is closed work retained as history.

concepts.label: Ticket lanes

concepts.definition: F13, work carriers, states which record carries work, what it may claim and when it closes. Its instance premises concern lifetimes, multiple apparent state surfaces, multiple tenants, migrations and variation among files, trackers and services. These premises are not supplied by foundation commitments. Its table distinguishes asserted consequences, domain/policy choices, owners and consumers.

grounding.quote:
Its instance premises, which the commitments do
not supply, are named in the rows as follows

concepts.label: F13 work-carrier family

concepts.definition: One run-scoped execution contract is used for each execution governed by the described method. Its source is the smallest lawful carrier selected by authority, exact existing coverage and required lifetime. Every execution governed by this method uses one run-scoped execution
contract.

concepts.definition: Admission validates a contract against its cited product outcome, prerequisite or experiment basis; it does not admit or renew that basis. Minimum contract states are drafted, admitted, rejected and superseded. The goals-work-wave owner or explicitly bounded proxy owns basis admission or renewal, durably recorded in existing goals or ticket authority.

grounding.quote:
Admission validates a contract against its cited product outcome,
prerequisite or experiment basis and does not admit that basis

concepts.label: Execution contract admission

concepts.definition: Evaluation criteria and non-closure conditions describe progress/completion and persistent failure despite green local proof. The source calls them the local gain function and, for migration, an anti-self-deception surface.

At minimum it should make `evaluation_criteria` and
`non_closure_conditions` visible. These are the local gain function for
the work

concepts.label: Evaluation criteria and non-closure conditions

concepts.definition: Ticket and work-instruction terms resolve through PRODUCT_DEFINITION §5 bounded-context semantic resolution. A cited product, re-entry surface, execution basis and affected scope jointly determine whether exactly one contextual meaning is selected.

grounding.quote:
Ticket and work-instruction terms resolve under the bounded-context
semantic resolution of PRODUCT_DEFINITION §5.

conditions: ticket_category is implementation_migration.

A ticket with `ticket_category: implementation_migration` carries both an

are part of the ticket authority, not optional commentary.

concepts.definition: A migration ticket declares local rebuilding, consumption of an existing reusable library/commonisation surface, or extension of that surface before local implementation lands. Recurrence review and commonisation do not establish shared identity merely from similar code.

An implementation migration ticket declares whether the active boundary is
rebuilding a pattern locally, consuming an existing reusable library or
commonisation surface, or extending that surface before the local
implementation lands; `library_usage` records which

concepts.label: Library usage and recurrence

conditions: Core-interface, carrier or authoritative-contract migration.

The checklist is a named walk of every live
interface that can still bypass, reinterpret, replay or project the
migrating truth path

concepts.label: Impacted Interface Review Checklist

concepts.definition: Independent assessment is distinct from construction self-review and owner acceptance. A reviewer is not the reviewed subject's author. Review evaluates; the decision owner disposes acceptance; stated conditions determine closure; closed-result reuse belongs to ACTIVATION §7.

grounding.quote:
a constructor's self-review is construction
output

Authority to author or implement a change is not independent authority to
verify it.

concepts.definition: Reusable residual judgment J and direct or lawfully proxied owner ruling O are distinct records carried with existing work. J is not O, and recording either cannot create admission,

concepts.label: Recorded judgment, owner ruling and obligation standing

concepts.definition: A work claim binds exact subject, basis, scope and declared obligation coverage. Its closure condition is the source-described conjunction of results; SPEC_METHOD §4 Consistency gate applies that condition to a declared change span.

This section owns the

ticket owns ticket state, milestone authority owns subordinate milestone

concepts.definition: Recommended document shapes are a sprint manifest, an ordinary ticket and an implementation-migration ticket. They carry prior required fields and sections and are examples, not instantiated work or accepted claims. The sprint example SPRINT-2026-04-30-operational-projection is active, goal operational-projection-ux, opened/updated 2026-04-30T09:00:00Z; it cites goals/product/design surfaces, scopes layout/readability/interaction/evidence work, excludes product truth, data contract, runtime/governance and new-carrier changes, expects realization_refactor, and records UXI-001 readability work with screenshot evidence and pending accessibility contrast. Its closure trigger is timebox, changed-surface volume or design-lead request; walkthrough checks each changed state, using screenshots/notes, declared accessibility/replay debt, hidden-drift non-closure and paydown/repricing policy. Ordinary example T-001 is an active high-priority feature/ordinary product_reprice at product, goal methodology-bootstrap, dated 2026-04-07; it makes the product layer explicit, with PRODUCT.md, intent -> product -> requirements, updated examples/reconstruction and a comment link. Migration example B-010 is an active bug/implementation_migration, inside_out_hard_break, library_usage none with boundary-specific rationale, goal operator-gap-truth, design_reframe at design_surface, dated 2026-04-20. Its affected operator-query gap scope excludes no other scope; fallback synthetic convergence is replaced by declared-obligation projection with separately classified fallback gaps; old producer build_fallback_gap gives way to collect_declared_obligations/build_canonical_gap; project_gaps/project_span/render are old and new consumers, with gaps/span/first_slice_negative derived surfaces. Its closure requires old projection authority removed and mixed proof excluded, and its checklist remains unchecked.

grounding.quote:
These shapes are the recommended carriers of the fields and sections the
rules above require; a project may bind another shape that carries the
same fields
- closure_law: migration closes only when the old projection is no longer authoritative within the affected scope and mixed old/new proof does not count as acceptance

conditions: Sprint close is initiated.
exceptions: Local paydown debt may survive only when the governing method allows explicit follow-up.

grounding.quote:
Sprint close begins by moving the manifest to `status: closing`. While
closing: new iteration inside that sprint is frozen

constraints.statement: Move the manifest to closing; freeze new iteration; review every included ticket/iteration against the manifest; check evidence durability; walk changed surfaces against cited authority; classify deferred compliance; open paydown tickets for debt surviving review. Closed requires classification of every item and debt entry and durable resulting paydown/repricing work, not satisfied outcomes for all. Hidden authority drift cannot be accepted.
constraints.uncertainty: The governing method's particular permission for debt survival is not supplied.

conditions: Each reviewed item is classified under the sprint authority.
exceptions: remove has no matching ACTIVATION §3 disposition.

grounding.quote: | `remove` | none | falsified | the work is backed out or kept out of closure; the reason for removal is the counterexample. No disposition of ACTIVATION §3 has this condition, because removal does not require a violated governing relation or a competing truth path |

constraints.statement: For predicate 'the reviewed item is accepted as compliant under the sprint authority', exactly one core value is attached: accepted→accept/satisfied for compliance; local_paydown→local_repair/falsified because ticketed local debt is the counterexample, with coherent governing relation and repair carried by a surviving paydown ticket; design_reframe→re_enter/invalid_basis because accepted governing design must change; requirement_reprice→re_enter/invalid_basis because a governing requirement must change; product_reprice→re_enter/invalid_basis because product definition changes beyond cited authority; remove→no disposition/falsified, with the removal reason the counterexample. Items needing authority change take repricing, not local_paydown. The candidate is the reviewed item and the boundary is sprint close under cited authority; classification consumes review results while remaining separate from them, like acceptance from assessment. Repricing layer is a declared domain outcome, not an additional result.
constraints.uncertainty: Full imported disposition/core definitions are unavailable.

conditions: A debt entry is classified at the sprint-close boundary.

grounding.quote:
The mappings
add no disposition and no core value. The condition for `closed`
above requires an outcome for every item and debt entry, not a
`satisfied` one.

constraints.statement: For predicate 'the debt entry is accepted under the sprint authority', accepted→accept/satisfied; ticketed→local_repair/falsified; removed→no matching disposition/falsified; repriced→re_enter/invalid_basis, on the corresponding item-classification grounds. These newly authored mappings add neither dispositions nor core values. Consumers combining close outcomes with other results must not read remaining debt, needed repricing or removal as compliance.

conditions: A ticket carrier is selected.

grounding.quote:
A repository or external tracker carrier is lawful only
when it preserves the required ticket contract, history, state transition,
stable identity, searchability and closure semantics without a co-equal
local copy

constraints.statement: Each ticket has exactly one durable authoritative record. A repository/external tracker alternative must preserve contract, history, state transition, stable identity, searchability and closure semantics without a co-equal local copy. A local filename should contain a stable id and short slug; T-001-add-product-layer.md, B-002-fix-reset-manifest-id.md, S-003-evaluate-integration-capability.md and C-004-clean-up-trace-tags.md are recommended examples, not mandatory exact names.

conditions: Backlog or active tickets; completed tickets only if reopened or explicitly repriced.
Duplication applies only when the same admitted work item genuinely has multiple tenant execution lines.
exceptions: Upstream-only work has no tenant duplicate yet; single-tenant work needs no sibling duplicate.
constraints.statement: Three lawful cases are upstream-only authority ticket, single tenant-local execution ticket, or multi-tenant work with its own upstream authority ticket and one suffixed tenant-local ticket per execution line. Preserve upstream authority; append tenant mnemonic to id and filename; put multi-tenant backlog/active execution and closure on those duplicates. No ticket claims closure for multiple build-tenant lifecycles. Status, proof, closure, repricing and reopening stay independent; another tenant's green status cannot hide blockers or false closure. A duplicate should record source_ticket and build_tenant. build_tenant identifies the product how.build_tenants entry; path, alias or tracker label substitutes only if product definition binds it as identity. The unsuffixed base may remain upstream product/design authority. B-030 with B-030-T1/B-030-T2 are recommended naming examples.
constraints.uncertainty: Tenant registry and its identity bindings are not supplied.

conditions: Every ticket for the base fields; category/tenant/library conditions select additional mandatory fields.
exceptions: superseded_truth is recommended only when relevant; source_ticket recommendation applies to duplication/derivation.

grounding.quote:
Each ticket records at least `id`, `title`, `type`, `ticket_category`,
`status`, `goal`, `change_intent`, `change_class`, `re_entry_point`,
`triaged_at`, `created_at` and `updated_at`

constraints.statement: Minimum ticket fields: id, title, type, ticket_category, status, goal, change_intent, change_class, re_entry_point, triaged_at, created_at, updated_at. Recommended additions: priority, dependencies, links, intake_source, affected_boundary, source_ticket for duplicate/derived work, build_tenant for tenant-local work. Implementation migrations additionally require migration_strategy and library_usage, governing_library for consume/extend, library_rationale for none; tenant-local implementation migrations require build_tenant and source_ticket when derived/duplicated from upstream source/product/design work. For execution-contract admission the runtime-drafted contract should additionally carry at minimum target_truth, relevant superseded_truth, closure_law, evaluation_criteria, non_closure_conditions and proof_surface.

grounding.quote:
A ticket records the `change_class`
declared by intake triage

constraints.statement: Record intake triage's SPEC_METHOD §4 change_class. Common, nonexclusive pairings: feature with goal/intent/product/requirement repricing or design_reframe; bug with requirement_reprice, design_reframe or realization_refactor; chore with design_reframe or realization_refactor. Spike remains exploratory but carries its current triage class and should end in a specific downstream ticket or explicit no-further-substantive-change decision. Category controls execution/closure discipline and class controls constitutional re-entry, so bug + implementation_migration + design_reframe is consistent.
constraints.uncertainty: Full SPEC_METHOD class definitions are not supplied.

conditions: A bug is classified or realization_refactor is proposed.
exceptions: Missing or ambiguous evidence leaves treatment unknown rather than establishing an absent governing layer.

grounding.quote:
checks each layer and stops at the highest layer found missing or
insufficient for the authorised outcome, and the class is the one that
re-enters there

constraints.statement: The work carrier references the exact computed result and residuals; a new role does not repeat an unchanged walk. Before bug realization_refactor, establish that current requirement and accepted realising design govern the behaviour and suffice for the authorised outcome; presence alone proves no coverage. Use the smallest lawful re-entry exposed by SPEC_METHOD §4: a candidate's public violation selects no new contract, and governing-owner re-entry requires explicit desired-outcome change or established governing insufficiency. Walk upward from realised surface through each layer: missing/insufficient requirement→requirement_reprice at requirement owner; sufficient requirement but missing/insufficient design→design_reframe at Design; actual Goal/Intent/Product change→corresponding repricing at its owner, not a familiar file; sufficient requirement/design with deviating implementation→realization_refactor, repair or reject candidate. Stop at the highest established missing/insufficient layer. Unresolved meaning remains J; reserved choice remains O.
constraints.uncertainty: Source-disposition shorthand later says 'first missing layer'; the operative section says highest missing or insufficient layer.

conditions: The ticket is for substantive work.

grounding.quote: The recorded values are those intake triage declared

constraints.statement: The durable ticket records intake-declared change_intent, lawful change_class, lawful re_entry_point and triaged_at. Recording does not substitute a newly inferred class for triage's declared values.

grounding.quote:
a declared state is never combined as an evaluation result, so
a ticket marked `completed`, or a sprint marked `closed`, cannot stand in
for a `satisfied` result

constraints.statement: Ticket/sprint statuses, local states, lanes, migration/library values and change_class must not be combined as evaluation results. Completed and closed do not imply satisfied. Close classifications and debt outcomes are results with their separate mappings; evaluating any declared state requires its own predicate and core value.

grounding.quote:
completed tickets move to `ticketing.tickets.lanes.completed`, by default
`.ai-workspace/tickets/completed/`

constraints.statement: Place backlog and active work at the product's corresponding lane bindings and move completed work to the completed binding; the supplied local paths are defaults, not replacements for product bindings.
constraints.uncertainty: Actual product bindings are not supplied.

conditions: A derived surface or projected frame is insufficient.

grounding.quote:
the actor reads this member only for the named unresolved lifecycle or
proof question and cites the clauses used

constraints.statement: The source-described actor reads TICKETS only for the named unresolved lifecycle/proof question and cites clauses used. Prompt construction belongs to ACTIVATION §2. The source attributes this reading policy to rc.2 compression provenance while explicitly saying no rc.2 body states the claim.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited compression and ACTIVATION text are not supplied.

conditions: The respective lifetime, multiple-surface, tenant, migration or carrier-variation premise applies.

grounding.quote:
The table accounts for §1 to §9, and for POSTING_GUIDE §2, §7 and §9,
which have no family table of their own. §10 records dispositions and
decides nothing.

constraints.statement: The table asserts: record obligations whose lifetime exceeds a run before return; use the smallest carrier and ticket-state authority for durable tickets; execute only under admitted upstream authority with one exact execution/closure basis; maintain one authority chain, with comments provisional posts until adoption and milestones proving only their own claims; rebind carriers explicitly with no rival; sprint-batch only repeated bounded closure law, defer only declared local proof as escrow, never triage, and remove law-changing work to its re-entry layer; retain triage; preserve tenant-local lifecycle/evidence; require migration negative/structural evidence, source-first dependence and recurrence review without automatic merge; distinguish author/verification authority, durable bounded judgments and invalidation; close only on all applicable obligations and no non-closure condition, with tests from authority; block affected admission/closure for unresolved material terms; allow shapes preserving fields/sections and bounded source reading. It labels P0 recovered, P1/P2/P3/P4a/P6 independent, P4b derived from P0/P2 under non-reacquirable-step-facts premise, and P5 derived from P0/P6 under open-world premise. Carrier kinds/selection, default layouts/lanes/statuses, sprint provision/fields/classifications, ticket fields/types/categories/tenant suffixes, migration declarations/checklists/thresholds/questions/order, four repricing states, reconciliation order and recommended shapes/reading policy are TICKETS choices. Product definition owns carrier locations/rebinding, admission mechanism/result surface and tenant identity; governing method owns debt survival; SPEC_METHOD owns change classes/migration law; POSTING_GUIDE owns post structure/states; EVALUATION/ACTIVATION own assessment/reuse; FOUNDATIONS/ASSURANCE own conjunction/test law; product semantic resolution owns term meaning. Choices are not represented here as derived proofs.
constraints.uncertainty: The standing of these asserted derivations and imported laws cannot be established from the supplied excerpts.

conditions: A listed consumer applies a family-table rule.
exceptions: Term binding and carrier-shape/reading rows identify no separate external consumer.

grounding.quote:
Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not

constraints.statement: Consumer references confer no decisions beyond the owning rule. Reported routes: lifetime selection→SPEC_METHOD §4 Carriers, PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8 location-only, CONFORMANCE discriminator 41 and continuity recording; admission→ACTIVATION §1 and ODD manual-walkthrough row; authority chain→PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8 and shapes; sprint mechanics→SPEC_METHOD sprint boundary/change classes, UX §§12/15/family table, CONFORMANCE discriminator 48, Status, closure reuse and shapes, without remapping UX outcomes or inferring admission/compliance/closure from status/classification; triage→SPEC_METHOD classes, sprint admission, carrier selection and ordinary shape; tenant lifecycles→SPEC_METHOD §11 and product registry; migration→adopted DESIGN_MODULE §10 refinement, Status and migration shape; independent assessment→EVALUATION §3, EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §§10/12-step-4/17 and Reviewer row, SPEC_METHOD computed treatment and recurrence follow-up boundaries; condition closure/tests→SPEC_METHOD consistency/evidence, EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §22/family table, ASSURANCE §3 and milestones. Term binding acts internally in admission/closure; product layout/bootstrap does not thereby apply the recommended-shapes rule.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced consumer sections outside this selection are descriptive leads, not reconstructed endpoints.

conditions: Work governed by the described method is considered for execution.

grounding.quote:
first establish the applicable upstream
work authority, then select the first matching row below.

constraints.statement: Establish upstream authority then take the first matching case, with local boundary admitted sprint if inside one, otherwise current run: (1) no authority→no admitted contract, no substitute-authority ticket; stop or re-enter; (2) exact admitted ticket covers work→derive run contract and reuse ticket, no duplicate; (3) authority, no exact ticket, work/open obligation needs independent state beyond boundary→durable ticket plus run contract, create/update only with ticket-state authority; (4) authority, no exact ticket, work wholly in admitted sprint with no post-close state→manifest plus one local iteration, no durable ticket; (5) authority, no exact ticket/sprint, work ends this run without surviving state→intake-drafted run contract, no durable ticket. Ticket absence neither requires nor authorises creation. Exact product-authorised instruction may supply one-run work authority; generic requests/model-widened scope cannot. Explicit ticket-state-authority instruction selects durability but neither admits execution nor widens upstream authority.

grounding.quote:
A carrier's lane, status or
prose that asserts admission without those coordinates is not admission
evidence, and the contract it describes remains drafted or rejected.

constraints.statement: ACTIVATION §1 owns drafting/admission within invocation, execution-start condition, admitted-result coordinates, recording every result/withheld closure/residual before return, and refusal without durable result/evidence surface. Product definition binds mechanism and surface; if ticket/manifest is that surface, record admitted result and coordinates there. Presence, lane, active status or prose without coordinates is no admission evidence; contract stays drafted or rejected. Absent/rejected admission returns missing work authority without execution. Before return preserve surviving obligations: sprint-local entry if lifetime stays inside admitted sprint; otherwise durable ticket only with ticket-state authority; without that authority use named durable result/evidence surface or already-authorised enclosing carrier, mark closure withheld on ticket-state authority, and return required re-entry. Execution and closure use identical admitted categorisation, criteria, proof surface and non-closure conditions; resulting state still undergoes proof, gap analysis and repricing.
constraints.uncertainty: Exact coordinates and step-side admission law are referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote:
A ticket's
`active` status, its lane, or an admitted or retained contract is therefore
never the admission of a growth basis

constraints.statement: Runtime flow should treat ticket, sprint entry and drafted contract as admission candidates, never automatic truth. Carry at least drafted/admitted/rejected/superseded states. An admitted contract should be logged in runtime/event truth and available to prompt assembly and later closure checking so both read the same basis. Self-certification refusal belongs to ACTIVATION §1. Active status, lane and admitted/retained contract never admit a growth basis; only its owning authority or explicitly bounded proxy admits/renews it, durably legible in goals/ticket authority.
constraints.uncertainty: External self-certification and basis-admission procedures remain unresolved.

exceptions: Residual debt outside the claimed acceptance path is not by itself non-closure; deferral requires SPEC_METHOD §7 path-relative authority and explicit disposition.

grounding.quote:
Residual implementation debt outside the claimed acceptance path is not by
itself a non-closure condition.

constraints.statement: Contracts should expose completion/progress and failure despite some green local proof, at minimum visible evaluation_criteria/non_closure_conditions. Typical migration non-closure conditions are old authoritative path still passing normally in affected scope, mixed proof accepted, proxy/partial interface in acceptance path, reachable competing/ambiguous executable authority on claimed product acceptance path, and unreconciled ticket/product/proof wording. These are substantive execution conditions, not optional commentary; their description as typical does not eliminate path-relative applicability or separately stated compatibility exceptions.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed path-relative deferral rules are external.

conditions: A ticket spans contexts or a material term has competing meanings.
exceptions: An unqualified term is permitted when cited product, re-entry surface, execution basis and affected scope select exactly one bounded-context meaning.

grounding.quote:
An unresolved or multiply resolved material term blocks execution-contract
admission and closure for the affected claim.

constraints.statement: Cite applicable product-definition disambiguation or owner-authorised import/translation/equivalence/disambiguation carrier; referencing the relation may replace duplication. Prose, actor familiarity, matching glossary heading, tenant placement and comment context neither select meaning nor transfer authority. An unresolved/multiply resolved material term blocks affected admission and closure; opening/updating its ticket merely records pressure. Re-enter the owner of the missing context or semantic relation.
constraints.uncertainty: Product semantic-resolution law and actual mappings are not supplied.

conditions: ticket_category is implementation_migration.
exceptions: If there are no excluded/disjoint scopes, explicitly declare absence; silence is insufficient.

grounding.quote:
The declaration states: the migration strategy used for this work item; the
exact affected migration scope

constraints.statement: Carry explicit authoritative declaration and live-markdown hard checklist. Declaration names strategy, exact affected scope, every excluded/disjoint product or compatibility scope and deterministic routing, old/superseded and new/authoritative paths, old and new producer/consumer sets, every derived projection/report/status/proof surface, and closure law. Minimum checklist covers affected and excluded/routed scopes, explicit old/new paths, new producers/consumers, projection/read-model surfaces, removal/demotion of old authority within scope, rejection of mixed-state closure evidence, removal/repricing of mixed-behaviour tests, recurrence review against reusable surfaces, library usage with governing library/rationale, one tenant lifecycle per multi-tenant backlog/active ticket with suffixed siblings, and reconciliation of ticket/product/proof wording before closure. migration_strategy must be inside_out_hard_break or fundamental_re_adoption; library_usage must be none, consume or extend. consume/extend names governing_library; none gives library_rationale that no reusable surface applies, pattern is boundary-specific, or not yet a lawful recurrence/commonisation candidate.

conditions: Migration closure is claimed or a completed ticket's closure checks are reviewed.
exceptions: Explicitly declared and ticket-justified retained compatibility may remain within affected scope.
Deterministically routed, non-overlapping scope outside the declared migration retains its own current authority.

grounding.quote:
Closure is blocked while the old authoritative interface still passes in
normal execution within the declared affected scope, unless the ticket
explicitly declares a retained compatibility feature.

constraints.statement: Block closure while old authority still passes in normal affected-scope execution. It cannot remain silently authoritative; any retained path is named compatibility rather than native truth and justified in the ticket, never inferred from code. Mixed green old/new tests and proxy/partial implementations do not establish migration closure. If later current-tree review falsifies checked closure items on a completed ticket, reopen it or create explicitly linked successor; false closure is a ticket-method defect as well as potentially a code defect. An intermediate product slice may be accepted under SPEC_METHOD §7 path-relative promotion, but its ticket remains active until checklist and final closure law are satisfied. Ticket wording cannot narrow derived slice authority; active status renews no exhausted growth authority. Removal, demotion and proof work may continue within the external bound; further material producer/consumer growth requires a separately admitted SPEC_METHOD §3 basis.
constraints.uncertainty: Slice derivation, promotion and permitted continuation bounds are externally defined.

conditions: Selected migration_strategy determines the applicable requirements.

grounding.quote: Unclassified inherited implementation blocks closure

constraints.statement: inside_out_hard_break requires a full best-guess contract-family interface inventory, deepest-source-outward break sequence, intentionally severed old seam for every break, and expected negative proof for each. fundamental_re_adoption requires human product authority's explicit selection; comparison with bounded evolution across product value, feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained predecessor semantics; bounded abort/re-entry condition; sideways reference line/prior implementation boundary as source material; module/interface adjudication surface; and explicit carry_across, redundant or rewrite classification for every inherited module, interface, carrier, projection and proof surface. Unclassified inherited implementation blocks closure.
constraints.uncertainty: SPEC_METHOD §7 meanings of the three inherited classifications are not supplied.

conditions: Every implementation-migration ticket, regardless of adopted profiles.
exceptions: After review establishes the pattern in two module boundaries or tickets, a third local rebuild is permitted only by consume, extend, or a linked explicit do-not-commonise design decision in library_rationale.
Outside recurrence rules and current applicable hard stops, discovered reusable patterns are repricing input, not automatic blockers/follow-up obligations.

grounding.quote:
the second
credible recurrence forces an explicit
library or commonisation review; the third local rebuild is not acceptable
by default.

constraints.statement: The second credible recurrence requires explicit library/commonisation review. If review finds the same pattern in two boundaries/tickets, a third local rebuild blocks implementation absent the stated exception. Preferred order is boundary-local cleanup, then tenant-local reuse, then shared/common propagation only through separate design re-entry. Adopting DESIGN_MODULE also applies §10 candidate/design-review refinement, without a rival threshold. Patterns found during active work remain subject to second/third recurrence rules. Otherwise they neither block the bounded claim nor require follow-up unless owning authority admits that follow-up.
constraints.uncertainty: DESIGN_MODULE's candidate criteria are not supplied.

conditions: The same work item is processed across multiple tenants; review covers backlog and active tickets.
exceptions: Upstream source/product/design ticket itself must change.

grounding.quote:
each ticket names its `build_tenant`; each tenant ticket has its
own proof surface and closure law

constraints.statement: Review checks a suffixed ticket for each tenant, named build_tenant, its own proof surface and closure law, and no substitution of another tenant's green proof. Reopening, repricing and successor work remain tenant-local except when upstream authority itself must change. This review requirement is stronger in its applicable setting than the general recommendation to record tenant fields.

conditions: Implementation-migration review; Functional Review Criteria are recommended for core-interface/carrier migrations.

grounding.quote:
For a core-interface or
carrier migration the ticket should include a `Functional Review Criteria`
section, specific to the ticket

constraints.statement: Make review concrete enough that rename/adapter/wrapper/happy-path proof cannot claim source-truth migration. Recommended criteria let reviewers ask: was control-flow meaning replaced by admitted carrier/algebra/event/source truth; was a semantic centre removed rather than relocated; is law typed/closed rather than open dict/string/config; is main step a pure transform rather than procedural law-making orchestration; are effects at publication/delivery edges; do consumers consume admitted carriers instead of reconstructing from payloads/.get/defaults/raw text/legacy files; are reports/projections derived rather than independent closure authority; where deterministic checks exist, do they inform state without structurally blocking a lawful constructive/probabilistic contract-permitted path; and where the pattern exists elsewhere, is reuse/extension explicit? Tests alone do not satisfy review. Keeping the same semantic centre behind typed wrappers, adapter policy, old lists beside algebra, fallback config or rehydrated dicts fails review despite green public behaviour.
constraints.uncertainty: The questions do not by themselves override explicit recurrence exceptions or establish an executed review.

conditions: Core-interface, carrier or authoritative-contract migration.
exceptions: A deferred interface may name its successor ticket or remain unchecked.
A compatibility shim counts only if explicitly justified as retained compatibility.

grounding.quote:
a checked box asserts truth on the current tree, not
intended direction

constraints.statement: Include the named checklist before tests become closure evidence. It walks every live bypass/reinterpret/replay/project interface. Where present, it should enumerate source-carrier builders; closure/register/projection builders; deepest kernel/adapter boundaries; public wrappers and bootstrap/replay/ingest/resume/query entries; prompt/report/projection/read-model surfaces; constructors/materialisation; proof lanes and negative fixtures. Each item states its own closure condition: examples require consume_projection to use admitted projection without raw helper authority, project_domain to remain read-model-only without rebuilding absent publication, and build_canonical_gap not to convert open rows into independent closure. A false checked item makes the ticket not closure-ready. Hard-break checklists describe seam inventory before test evidence; re-adoption checklists explicitly classify inherited carried/dropped/rewritten modules/interfaces; implicit carry-forward does not count.

conditions: An implementation migration touches a core interface.
exceptions: An equivalent ordered execution section may replace the Required Break Order heading.
constraints.statement: Require source-outward ordered execution: discover full best-guess family; publish/admit new source; sever and keep broken an old authoritative seam; rebind deepest kernel; remove/demote old producers; rebind consumers; reprice projections/reports/prompts/delivery/tests. Multiple old interfaces additionally require a Break-To-Closure Map identifying the closure-law clause each break closes. Explicit review defects are wrappers retaining old semantics, parallel old authoritative read models, renamed proxies/partial old interfaces, constructor/replay/ingest/resume/bootstrap/public-wrapper admission bypasses, projections/tests passing without new carrier, fallback invention of policy/identity/target/closure truth, and downstream proof passing while upstream source work remains open.
constraints.uncertainty: The ordered procedure is represented as data; no break or traversal is performed.

conditions: Migration proof is offered.
exceptions: Explicitly specified retained compatibility may keep an old path.
A deterministically routed non-overlapping external scope retains its authority and does not block merely because its old path works.

grounding.quote:
For a migration ticket, positive behaviour proof is not enough. The proof
surface should include at least one negative or structural proof that
the old path can no longer satisfy the closure law

constraints.statement: Positive behaviour alone is insufficient; the proof surface should include at least one negative/structural proof that old truth cannot satisfy closure. Examples: reject severed seam before downstream progress; fail closed when new carrier is removed from advancement/closure/prompt/projection; reject legacy payload rather than rehydrate; when old/new disagree, new wins or fail closed; reject structurally different same-name carrier/function/route/policy/projection source; avoid undeclared local fixtures/mutable sibling dependencies. Keep ticket open if old path works normally within affected scope or remains reachable on claimed acceptance path, subject to explicit compatibility. With an interface checklist, negative proof exercises named public consumers material to closure; bypassing one shim is insufficient if live authority already bypasses it through other helpers/loaders/rebuilders.
constraints.uncertainty: The local 'should include' recommendation is preserved; the F13 table separately describes negative or structural evidence as necessary for migration closure.

conditions: Independent assessment is required at product, qualification, release or explicitly risk-bearing boundaries that claim it, or additional boundaries imposed by governing basis.
exceptions: Not every local implementation step requires independent review.

grounding.quote:
A claimed independent review may support promotion or closure only when its
exact subject and verdict are durably traceable through an existing ticket,
commentary, qualification or release-evidence carrier.

constraints.statement: Author/implementation authority is not independent verification authority; reviewer is not author. Identify exact subject, basis, scope, exclusions, evidence, verdict and unresolved findings; findings cite current authority and code/proof paths, not historical commentary alone. Self-review remains authoring evidence; human acceptance/rejection does not make it independent. Promotion/closure support requires durable exact subject/verdict trace through existing ticket/commentary/qualification/release evidence; review-occurrence statements, unbound summaries and unavailable drafts are not verdicts. No separate receipt, carrier or review round is required. Verdict is bounded by reviewed claim and hard stops; EVALUATION §5 owns promotion-blocking triggers and treatment of out-of-bound observations, with no extra ticket-local trigger.
constraints.uncertainty: External independence protocol and finding-blocking conditions are not supplied.

conditions: A direct/lawfully proxied human ruling exists; agentic construction requirements apply where ACTIVATION §1 is bound by SPEC_METHOD §8.

grounding.quote:
Ticket state, ticket prose or
an admitted execution contract cannot widen that basis or substitute for
the live-surface assessment the relation requires

constraints.statement: Give a human ruling durable disposition before the next affected acceptance boundary; preserve wording separately from interpretation, do not widen it, and do not count ticket opening as satisfaction. Where agentic construction applies, active work identifies selected basis, bounded affected relations, delegated construction/assessment authority and re-entry conditions; it may reference accepted design/evidence instead of restating them. Ticket state/prose/admitted contract neither widen basis nor replace live-surface assessment. Existing ticket/commentary/commit/qualification/release evidence may carry reviewable transition; no new state, document type, review round or approval ceremony is required. TICKETS owns selection/traceability, not imported execution semantics.
constraints.uncertainty: Exact agentic construction and transition-evidence semantics remain external.

conditions: A residual judgment is needed by another activation or an owner ruling must be retained.
exceptions: A rule-settled question needs no invented J record.

grounding.quote:
A residual judgment that another activation needs is recorded once, with
its owning work, in the existing carrier selected under §5.

constraints.statement: Record needed residual judgment once in owning work's selected existing carrier, identifying question, exact subject/basis, computed facts/evidence, responsible actor/authority, scoped conclusion, uncertainty and concrete revising observation. Record owner ruling in original wording with owner, exact subject/basis, permitted scope/effects, conditions/source, separate from interpretation. Consume the same applicable ruling without widening or re-requesting unchanged authority; return only newly ambiguous/materially changed affected question to owner. Neither J nor O recording grants admission, acceptance, effects or continuation. Records follow run/sprint/ticket lifetime and named result/evidence surface; no registry, ticket per judgment or extra ceremony is required.

conditions: A later role or resumed run consumes recorded results.
exceptions: New role or conversation alone invalidates nothing.
Required independent assessment cannot be satisfied by reusing the author's judgment.

grounding.quote:
reuse cannot silently turn unknown facts into
established premises

constraints.statement: Recover and check applicability instead of re-authoring unchanged judgment. Changed material inputs (including supporting computed facts/evidence), stated revising observation or basis invalidate affected results; preserve original and successor relation, retain only demonstrably independent results, and reassess affected scope. Current C outputs may be referenced, but unknown facts cannot silently become premises. Independent assessor may use valid C, must acquire sufficient exact evidence and supply its own judgment under actual independence.
constraints.uncertainty: Full ACTIVATION reuse law is unavailable.

conditions: Obligations are repriced.

grounding.quote:
a retained obligation is never read as satisfied, and a
superseded, deferred or withdrawn one never as discharged

constraints.statement: Give each affected obligation retained/superseded/deferred/withdrawn disposition in the same carrier with owner and applicable evidence. Preserve surviving work, explain changed dependencies, avoid copying unaffected history into a parallel ledger, and present owner decisions as short consequence deltas with original ruling separately preserved. General continuation accepts no undisclosed architectural/scope change. These owner-set standings are states with no core mapping, not candidate-acceptance dispositions or predecessor claims evaluated in qualification. Evaluation of a state supplies its own predicate/result. Retained never means satisfied; superseded/deferred/withdrawn never means discharged.

conditions: Completion or closure of a work claim is considered.
exceptions: Where no independent review or reserved acceptance is required, recording without review follows ACTIVATION §1; applicable sprint-close and design-profile law still apply.
constraints.statement: Complete only when every applicable declared obligation has valid evidence satisfying exact subject/basis/scope, every required judgment/ruling is present and applicable, and no active non-closure condition remains. Unknown applicability of a mandatory obligation or insufficient evidence withholds the dependent claim rather than falsifying it; evidence presence is insufficient. Existing owner decides reserved acceptance. Review evaluates conditions; its occurrence is not closure. Record exact evaluated scope, satisfied conditions, evidence and remaining residuals.
constraints.uncertainty: The no-review recording procedure and full conjunction algebra are external.

conditions: Previously recorded evidence/results are relied upon.
exceptions: Unrelated observations are bounded repricing input and neither reopen a satisfied claim nor expand work automatically.

grounding.quote:
each
invalidates the affected claim and its dependent results before further
reliance.

constraints.statement: Unchanged obligations reuse valid applicable evidence and recorded J/O. Material counterexample, changed evidence, stated revising observation of J or changed basis invalidate affected claim and dependent results before further reliance.

conditions: An acceptance predicate or substantive test expectation is used or responsibility changes.

grounding.quote:
An actual conflict in live authority
requires re-entry, not a test-only waiver

constraints.statement: A substantive test should derive through the stated ticket/triage/re-entry/authority chain. Acceptance predicates additionally need applicable supported entry/state and obligation under the governing operating/threat model. Existing tests cannot authorise excluded threats or retain superseded guards. Changed responsibility requires affected-predicate audit and retirement of unsupported expectations under owning basis without inventing replacement guards; live authority conflicts require re-entry. Code is evidence, not arbiter of mismatch. For fixed-ticket mismatch reconcile in order: ticket change_intent/change_class/re_entry_point/target_truth/superseded_truth/closure_law/evaluation_criteria/non_closure_conditions; triage and lawful owner re-entry; cited governing surface; test expectation; implementation. Code may reveal stale/incomplete/narrow tests but cannot alone authorise expectation changes. Before updating/removing a test predating lawful repricing, name governing ticket and superseding authority change. Stale/ambiguous/authority-deficient ticket returns to triage before code or test is treated as correct. A passing test is closure evidence only with trace to admitted ticket and governing chain.
constraints.uncertainty: ASSURANCE §3's general law is referenced, not reconstructed.

grounding.quote:
Contradiction between the owning ticket, its required milestones, the
current goals or the cited acceptance evidence blocks closure.

constraints.statement: Recency, visibility and repetition never promote projection to authority. Contradiction among owning ticket, required milestones, current goals or cited acceptance evidence blocks closure. Superseded evidence remains history and cannot be projected as current acceptance.

exceptions: A Product may optionally adopt the profile under its own authority.

grounding.quote:
Availability is not adoption. A Product that adopts the profile owns its
subject interpretation, concrete vocabulary, authorities, requirements,
design, implementation and evidence; this member imports none of those
consumer identities

It defines no process scheduler, event-log carrier, state store, workspace
format, rollback mechanism, actor topology or prospective reference-frame
profile

constraints.statement: Availability/inclusion in a method cut is no adoption or grant. Adoption instantiates one closed model-family signature over one exact imported basis; it neither amends a_c nor becomes universal to all models or an execution theory. Adopting Product owns subject interpretation, vocabulary, authorities, requirements, design, implementation and evidence; no consumer identities are imported. The profile grants no mutation/admission/evaluation/decision authority and defines no scheduler, event-log/store/workspace/rollback/actor topology or prospective frame profile. Local occurrence/frontier/cut/lineage meanings must not be conflated with core release cut/product lineage or another member's frontier.
constraints.uncertainty: Actual adoption and Product bindings are not supplied.

conditions: The profile is adopted with its instance premises.
exceptions: Snapshot/rollback, if any, is a separately authorised adopting-Product application.
Acyclicity applies to identity and causal subgraphs, not every typed lineage graph.

grounding.quote: a correction appends without erasing

constraints.statement: Each exact application is one immutable occurrence; changed inputs/reapplication mint another; correction appends without erasure. Observations/events/projections describe externally mutable reality and never replace its external subject. Candidate, judgment, admitting event and materialised relation stay distinct. Precedence orders admitted facts and decides no authority. Cause is admitted typed lineage, never inferred from time/order/adjacency/containment/correlation. identity_depends_on, causally_precedes_occurrence and causally_precedes_event are acyclic and carry admitted material cause, so identity/causal walks terminate at first cause. application_of target equals exact application seed; corrects_event preserves target. Missing seed retains hold; unresolved cause remains residual. The profile owns identity inputs and acyclicity policy; Product owns causal admissions, precedence/evaluators/authorities and any snapshot/rollback.
constraints.uncertainty: Exact occurrence identity inputs and relation contracts are referenced in unsupplied later sections.

conditions: An effect is considered or an occurrence intends an effect.
exceptions: Product may declare compatible territory containment instead of exact equality.

grounding.quote: an effect whose outcome the evidence cannot decide stays indeterminate, an established non-attainment of its intended outcome is falsified whether or not its end is established, and no refusal maps to success

constraints.statement: No operation is lawful without matching admitted owner-issued grant. Functor kind, traversal, operation, executor, actor, grant and invocation remain distinct. invokes_effect requires exact operation grant; authorized_by checks operation kind, target and territory; effect_readiness unauthorized/stale never dispatches. Every judgment decision, stop and intended-effect disposition maps to exactly one core value for a named predicate. Undecidable effect outcome stays indeterminate; established non-attainment is falsified whether or not effect end is established; no refusal maps to success. Profile owns decision/stop/residual vocabularies/mappings and exclusion of out_of_frame from constraint values. AC-007 owns hold/gap/two refusal meanings and causes; traversal-specific causal refinements retain parent core values. Structural defects in closed populations are falsified structural constraints; model-validation/structural-admission basis mismatch carries refuse_invalid_basis.
constraints.uncertainty: Full decision, stop, constraint, effect-disposition and grant-matching tables are not supplied; no additional mapping is inferred.

conditions: A frontier projection or semantic admission cut is represented.
exceptions: Not every framework event belongs to an occurrence.

grounding.quote: a projection binds one complete event frontier

constraints.statement: Projection binds one complete unchanged event frontier and is not read beyond it; a new admitted event creates a new frontier, not advancement of the old projection. All members of an admitted semantic cut name an identical source frontier; successor is that frontier plus exactly the admitted event; missing/inconsistent members refuse. event_for follows declared event-scope law, frontier_contains is complete membership under exact frontier basis, projects_frontier binds exactly one unchanged frontier. unresolved_scope, competing_lineage and stale_frontier remain residual categories. Product owns event scope/frontier laws. These representations supply neither event store nor projection implementation.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed frontier completeness, cut membership and compatible-event laws are not present.

conditions: A cited consumer applies F19 rules.
exceptions: Some rows state no separate consumer; no other member applies this profile's rule merely by listing it.

grounding.quote:
Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not

constraints.statement: F19's new table distinguishes foundation consequences from profile policy and Product-owned choices and adds no consumer decisions. It routes closed-boundary rules to closed kinds/Exclusions/conformance 1,2,9,21; immutable identity/correction to relation families, occurrence_seed_complete/occurrence_admission and conformance 3,14,15,18; mutable reality to Scope/conformance 13; effect grants/currentness to invokes_effect/authorized_by, pre_effect_current/operation_grant_contains_effect/effect_readiness and conformance 10,11,16; candidate separation to claim/event/cut admission, relation_claim_admissible, cross-basis-edge refusal, Exclusions and conformance 4–6; causality to identity/occurrence/event acyclicity and unresolved_cause, Exclusions and conformance 3,7,8,19; frontiers/cuts to event_for/frontier_contains/projects_frontier, semantic_cut_complete/event_scope_compatible/frontier_complete/frontier_projection and named residuals, Exclusions and conformance 9,17,18; core mappings to conformance 12; adoption to conformance 20 and Exclusions. A representative example/checker is neither occurrence engine nor semantic authority. Product authority owns adoption under PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7, whose listing of profiles applies none of their rules.
constraints.uncertainty: These named later sections and conformance items are absent; their names/routes do not establish their full semantics.

conditions: Occurrence signature instantiation or model validation is considered.

grounding.quote:
Missing populations, hidden records, refs
ambiguous between local and external, unknown record kinds and undeclared
field domains refuse model validation

constraints.statement: Import exact finite RecordKind_ac unchanged; declare complete finite sorts, relation/constraint/judgment/residual/stop kinds, auxiliary values, field-reference domains and exact inherited functor refs. Conflicts in basis, inherited meanings, shape, population, value/reference/relation domains, authority coordinates or refusal law invalidate instantiation. Only semantic objects use SemanticObject.value; all other families retain exact inherited coordinates. Population map is total over exactly RecordKind_ac; every fundamental record occupies exactly one finite population and local ids are unique across their disjoint union. Other I members resolve once through declared external reference domain/basis relation. Every identity-bearing value or inherited field is closed to exact local kind/sort or declared external kind. Qualified field includes source kind/sort and full nested path; equal labels do not merge domains. Missing populations, hidden records, local/external ambiguity, unknown kinds and undeclared domains refuse validation.

constraints.statement: Core sorts are exactly the listed nineteen; each value contract is closed and unknown/missing required fields refuse structural admission. SubjectBinding carries no mutable content digest. FrameworkEvent occurrence_ref_or_none is optional; occurrence-independent scope receives no fictional occurrence. Claim and claim-judgment fields are both absent or both exact; claim-admission events require both and current source_frontier_ref, while other kinds refuse them absent compatible extension. Use exact scoped identity refs, SHA-256 content digests and ordered duplicate-free identity-ref lists. observation_kind is pre_effect/post_effect/external_observation; effect disposition is no_effect/completed_effect/partial_effect/refused_effect; scope_class is occurrence_scoped/subject_scoped/authority_scoped. Every _ref resolves exactly once under AC-003; lists follow owning-signature order and reject duplicates. Product declares finite OperationKind instances through exact compatible signature/mapping; profile declares no consumer instances. EffectOperation lacking exact in-model or explicitly compatibly imported OperationKind refuses.
constraints.uncertainty: Full reference closure and extension-compatibility laws are external.
